thread:
Maria: quick question — thinking about adding a cost-per-token guard to canary autopause. proposal: trigger if avg_token_cost > $0.0004 AND p95_latency > 300ms over a 5m window. anyone see immediate problems?

Ashwin: cost guard makes sense but two caveats: 1) batching skews per-request token counts (we should use tokens/request metric), 2) high-cardinality per-tenant metrics could blow up our ingestion rates. :warning:

Lina: from UX side we need a way to show estimated spend impact before you flip this on. a small projected-cost delta and a simulation mode would help PMs sign off. :thinking:

Sam: also watch warmup anomalies — the model cache/KV warming can cause token amplification early on. suggest adding a min_sample threshold and a grace_period (e.g., ignore first 200 requests or 10m).

QA: we need deterministic e2e tests that can fake a cost spike + latency bump so autopause behaviour is reliable. can we add a test hook to the metrics pipeline?

Maria: draft guard DSL (very rough):
```yaml
guards:
  - name: cost_latency_autopause
    type: composite
    windows: 5m
    criteria:
      - metric: avg_token_cost
        op: gt
        value: 0.0004
      - metric: latency_p95
        op: gt
        value: 300ms
    min_samples: 100
    grace_period: 10m
    action: autopause
    notify: [slack:#eng-platform, email:owner]
```

Ashwin: DSL looks fine. backend limits: we should store only aggregated series: tokens_per_req(route, tenant, model) and req_count(route, tenant, model) on 1m rollups. that keeps cardinality bounded. also recommend a moving median on cost to avoid single-request noise.

Lina: UX additions: 1) 'simulate guard' toggle that runs the guard logic against historical 24h window and shows "would have paused X times" 2) UI to edit min_samples/grace_period inline 3) cost preview for projected monthly change.

Sam: +1 on simulate. add note: simulation should consider batching footprint — i.e., convert batch-level tokens into tokens/request before evaluation.

Maria: agree on aggregation and simulation. i'll open a PR for DSL docs and a minimal metrics ingestion change. tagging @Lina for UI mockups.

QA: we'll add a test harness that injects synthetic metrics (tokens_per_req spike + p95 bump) into the ingest and assert autopause triggers. also will assert no autopause during grace_period.

DeployBot: canary started for service=llm-routing variant=v1 at 1865001900

Ashwin: i'll prototype the ingestion sidecar this week — timeline ~3 days to get rollups flowing to metrics.

Maria: thanks. once ingestion is live we'll run the simulation on the last 7 days for a few tenants to calibrate threshold.

DeployBot: canary autopause triggered at 1865001989 — reason="cost_threshold + p95_latency" action=autopause

Lina: :thumbsup: nice catch. please post the simulation results + reproducer so UX can show exact numbers in the modal.

Sam: next steps: 1) ingest prototype (Ashwin) 2) DSL + docs PR (Maria) 3) UI mock + simulate button (Lina) 4) e2e test harness (QA). tagging all to coordinate.

Maria: i'll create a tracking GH issue and link to this thread. thanks everyone!
